subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should OpenClaw core accept this public Gateway context-engine control API and optional ContextEngine control hooks with the proposed status, doctor, and rotate semantics after the sanitizer and docs issues are fixed?
rationale: The branch creates a new core HTTP/API and plugin contract boundary; code review can identify hardening gaps, but only maintainers can confirm that this is the desired durable product/API shape.

options.title: Accept after hardening
options.body: Keep this API direction, require bounded error-code sanitization, user/plugin docs, and a clean rebase before merge.

options.title: Keep it private/plugin-owned
options.body: Reject the core HTTP surface for now and ask integrations to use existing plugin-specific or Gateway protocol paths until a broader control API is designed.

options.title: Defer to a broader control-plane RFC
options.body: Pause this PR and fold the context-engine controls into a larger Gateway control-plane design discussion.

recommendation.title: Accept after hardening
recommendation.body: Keep this API direction, require bounded error-code sanitization, user/plugin docs, and a clean rebase before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The central product contract is the ContextEngine API shape, and recent history points to jalehman as a strong context-engine routing owner.
